title: Conductor
content:
# Conductor

**代码**
- 主仓:`/mnt/c/Users/User/projects/conductor`(Windows 侧,docker compose 启动)
- WSL worktree:`/home/userray/workspace/conductor/T-conductor-001~019`(任务分支用,**不是 prod**)
- 仓库:`github.com/rayclaw3126/conductor`
- 栈:Python(FastAPI)+ Postgres + SQLAlchemy + Alembic

**运行**
- 容器:docker `conductor-api`,监听 localhost:7891
- DB:Postgres(docker compose 一起拉)
- alembic head:`021_state_table`

**公网入口(Cloudflare Tunnel)**
- 域名:https://conductor.rayaihq.com/
- Tunnel ID:`05fdab72-2333-49b1-a832-94822739a3a1`
- 配置:`/etc/cloudflared/config.yml`(WSL)
- 凭证:`/home/userray/.cloudflared/05fdab72-...json` + `cert.pem`
- systemd:`cloudflared.service`(enabled, active)
- ingress:conductor.rayaihq.com → http://localhost:7891

**核心页面**
- `GET /rules.json` — 铁规 JSON(当前 27 条)
- `GET /rules` — 铁规 CRUD UI
- `GET /state.json` — 本清单 JSON
- `GET /state` — 本清单 textarea + 实时 preview UI
- `PUT /state {content}` — 覆盖更新(自动 bump version + updated_at)

**Cron**(`~/conductor-logs/`)
- `budget-*` — 预算监控
- `reconcile-pr-*` — PR 对账(每 15 分钟)
- `backup-*` — 备份
- `check-containers.log` — 容器健康
- 完整 crontab 待跑 `crontab -l`(WSL)

**安全**
- pre-commit hook 防 token 泄漏
- session log 自动 redact API token

---

## 最近变更

### 2026-04-29

- **铁规库 28 条** — `/rules.json` 公网 JSON,Claude 新对话开局 fetch 注入
- **`/state` v2 多文档** — alembic `022_state_multi_doc`,5 slug;`/state.json` 保留旧契约
- **`POST /tasks` 加 API key 验证** — header `X-Api-Key`,`CONDUCTOR_TASKS_API_KEY`,fail-closed
- **成本告警** — daily report cron `0 0 * * *`(SG 8:00)+ 单任务 `cost_usd ≥ $5` 实时 hook(`cost.track()` 末尾,fail-soft)
- **api_low 告警** — `0 */6 * * * .../cron-runner.sh balances`,复用 `services/ammo.py` 的 `load_ammo()`,只告 `level=='bad'`
- **导航加「清单」链接** — `templates/partials/_nav.html`,`/state` 在「铁规」旁
